name: Cassidy Amber
source:
Whether it's a first-person shooter or a 2D Fighter game, Cassidy makes her true power shine with her controller in her hand. Her devoted fanbase, known as "Cassidy's Comrades", cheer on this Ultimate Pro Gamer at every tournament she attends. Her very presence can energize the venues, and she keeps her raw attitude front and center, letting you know she refuses to let anyone be pushed around, herself included.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1359285231572910080]official description[/url]]
